instruction: Find arXiv papers about 'Claude' language models from 2023 and add at least one paper to the spreadsheet, ensuring the arXiv PDF link is correctly formatted in column B.

parameters.window_name: New Large Language Models.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding Claude-related papers with properly formatted arXiv PDF links. The evaluator retrieves all links and titles from column B and A respectively, compares the current count against the initial count (stored in rules), and verifies that at least one new row was added with a valid arXiv PDF link (containing 'arxiv.org/pdf/'). Returns 1.0 if new papers were added with proper arXiv PDF links, 0.0 otherwise.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete requirement coverage: All four instruction requirements are verified: (1) papers about 'Claude' checked via case-insensitive title match (line 63), (2) papers from 2023 verified via arXiv ID year prefix check (line 57), (3) at least one paper added verified via count comparison (lines 30-31), (4) arXiv PDF link format validated (line 47).

Correct logic flow: Getter extracts links and titles from columns B and A. Metric correctly filters to only new entries using slicing (lines 34-35), then validates each new entry against all requirements using proper logic flow with early exits for invalid entries.
Appropriate postconfig: Activates spreadsheet window and saves file with Ctrl+S to ensure getter can read updated content. This is necessary for file-based verification.

Correct expected parameter handling: Metric correctly accesses 'initial_count' directly from expected dict (line 27: 'expected.get("initial_count", 0)'), which is correct for type='rule' where expected IS the rules dict.

Sound arXiv ID validation: Uses regex pattern to extract arXiv ID (line 40-51), then validates year by checking if ID starts with '23' for 2023 papers (line 57). This correctly handles arXiv ID format (YYMM.NNNNN).
